+def luqum_replace_child(parent: Item, old_child: Item, new_child: Item) -> None:
+    """Replace every direct child equal to ``old_child`` with ``new_child``."""
+    if not isinstance(parent, (BaseOperation, Group, Unary)):
+        raise ValueError("Not supported for generic class Item")
+
+    children = parent.children
+    if old_child not in children:
+        return
+    parent.children = type(children)(
+        new_child if child == old_child else child for child in children
+    )

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+def test_luqum_replace_child(parent: Item):
+    original_children = parent.children
+    old_child = Word('old')

+    assert luqum_replace_child(parent, old_child, replacement) is None
+    assert type(parent.children) is type(original_children)

+def test_luqum_replace_child_in_parsed_tree():

+            luqum_replace_child(
+                parents[-1], node, Word('baz', head=node.head, tail=node.tail)
+            )

+    assert str(tree) == 'foo OR baz'
